INTERNAL SECURITY ACT 1960
INTERNAL SECURITY (RESTRICTED ARBA) ORDER 1982

IN exercise of the powers conferred by regulation 3 of the Internal
Security (Restricted Articles) Regulations 1973, the Minister makes
the following Order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Internal Security (Restricted
Area) Order 1982 and shall come into force on the Ist July 1982.

2. The area described in the Schedule hereto is declared to be a
restricted area.
SCHEDULE

The whole area declared as the controlled area in the First
Schedule of the Internal Seourity (Controlled Area) Order
published as LN. 214 on 25th August 1960, as may from time
to time be amended, excluding the areas declared as the
Residential Areas in the Second Schedule thereof and the
roads specified in the Fourth Schedule thereof.

Made the 24th June 1982,
[KHEDN. Y. 14/TII/D; PN. (PU?) 216.)

Dato' Musa Hiram,
Minister of Home Affairs

AKTA PENYEMAKAN UNDANG-UNDANG 1968

PERINTAH PENYEMAKAN Undang-Undang (Akta HIDROGEN
SIANID) (PEWASAPAN) 1953) 1982

Pada menjalankan kuasa-kuasa yang diberi oleh seksyen 15 Akta
Penyemakan Undang-Undang 1968, Pesuruhjaya Penyemak
Undang-Undang, dengan kelulusan Jawatankuasa Penyemakan
Undang-Undang, membuat Perintah yang berikut:

1, Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penyemakan
Undang-Undang (Akta Hidrogen Sianid (Pewasapan) 1953) 1982
dan hendaklah disifatkan telah mula berkuatkuasa pada 24hb
Disember 1981.

2. Akta Hidrogen Sianid (Pewasapan) 1953 adalah diperbetulkan
dengan menggantikan perkataan "internment" yang terdapat di
baris akhir seksyen 6 (2) Akta dengan perkataan "interment".

Diperbuat pada 17hb Jun 1982.
(PN. (S.U. 2) 159; PN. (PU?) 231.)

Tan Sri DATUK CHANG Min Tat,
Pesuruhjaya Penyemak Undang-Undang,
Malaysia

REVISION OF LAWS ACT 1968

REVISION OF LAws (HYDROGEN CYANIDE (FUMIGATION)
Act 1953) Order 1982

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 15 of the Revision Ac: 1.
of Laws Act 1968, the Commissioner of Law Revision, with the
approval of the Law Revision Committee, makes the following
Order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Revision of Laws (Hydrogen Citation and
Cyanide (Fumigation) Act 1953) Order 1982 and shall be deemed trent"
to have come into force on 24th December 1981.

2. The Hydrogen Cyanide (Fumigation) Act 1953 is rectified Rectification
by substituting the word "interment" for the word "internment" * "7
appearing in the last line of section 6 (2) of the Act.

Made the 17th June 1982.
(PN. (S.U. 2) 159; PN. (PU?) 231.)
